title: ISO 17025 Accredited Calibration Services
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC.MISSION INSTALLATION CONTRACTING COMMAND.418TH CSB.W6QM MICC-DUGWAY PROV GRD
detail_text: SPECIAL NOTICE PHASE 2 THIS IS A SPECIAL NOTICE ONLY. The U.S. Government currently intends to award a contract for Accredited Calibration Services on a “Sole Source Basis”, as there was no interest in the related Sources Sought Notice posted on 02/18/2026. A signed FAR Part 6 Sole Source Justification and Approval (JA) has been completed as no other sources have been identified. The government intends to award, on a Sole Source basis utilizing: Coast to Coast Calibrations 9150 Isanti Street NE Blaine, MN 55449 USA (952) 881-7716 Vision Research is the Original Equipment Manufacturer. The FAR Authority and U.S. Code are: 6.302-1. Only one responsible source and no other supplies or service will satisfy agency requirements. This acquisition is conducted under the authority of United States Code (U.S.C.) 10 U.S.C. 2304(c)(1) or 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(1). It is the responsibility of potential offerors to monitor the Government-wide Point of Entry for additional information pertaining to this requirement. The NAICS code is: 541380. SBA Size Standard is 19 Million. THE PSC IS J052. This notice will be distributed solely through the Contracting Opportunities (Formerly FBO) Website (https://sam.gov/search?index=opp). Interested parties are responsible for monitoring the site to ensure they have the most up-to-date information about this acquisition. The point of contact concerning this sources sought action is Mr. Nicholas Rowton, Contract Specialist at (435) 831-2026, or email nicholas.j.rowton.civ@mail.mil. Responses are due by 3:00 PM (MDT) on 10 March 2026 .
